protocol.task_pool: V4: the V3 drift-hardened 31-task pool with the HN contract fixed (schema matches backend, 2026-11-25 review decision); ground truth built from the same live APIs before the eval
protocol.hn_schema_note: consistent contract (main protocol): get_hn_item.story_id is an integer in the agent-visible schema, matching the backend and the real HN API; the synthetic drift is not injected here. The drift-based repair capability is demonstrated separately in live_demo_hard_v3.json and its attribution control live_demo_hard_v3_hnconsistent.json

budget_conditions.clean+1: per-task turn budget = fault-free calibration turns + 1
budget_conditions.clean+4: per-task turn budget = fault-free calibration turns + 4

calibration.description: one fault-free run per task measured the turn requirement that anchors the budget sweep

fault_injection.model: deterministic transient fault epochs: the first N attempts of a faulted logical call fail (timeout / HTTP 429 / HTTP 5xx), then the real call runs

protocol.verification: programmatic; ground truth computed from the same live APIs before the runs

limitations: Deterministic transient-fault injection (first *attempts_to_fail* attempts of a faulted logical call fail), not observed production failures; the injection rate and epoch length are experimental parameters, not measured values.
Single model (deepseek-v4-flash) by decision; repeat seeds vary the injected fault surface only, they do not re-sample model behaviour.
The budget sweep uses per-task budgets calibrated from one fault-free run per task; the calibrated turn requirement is itself a point estimate (no repeat of calibration).

Task-pool provenance: V1 artifact = 20 tasks (commit 02ac71a), V2 artifact = 32 tasks (commit 43c4e89), V3 artifact = 31 tasks with drift-hardened ground truth (HN karma replaced by immutable account-creation year, commit 8ad347e). This runner now produces the V3 task-pool artifact; older artifacts are reproduced from their commits.

Ground truth is built once before the whole eval (single model, ~30 min run); weather/FX are live values and drift slightly, absorbed by the verifier tolerances. The V3 pool has no live-mutable HN karma tasks.
Failure-mode classification ('format_miss' vs 'no_expected_value') is a heuristic over the expected scalars, not an LLM judgement.
Free public APIs are not production grade; API drift can affect reruns, and the GitHub API is excluded because of the key-free rate limit.

Main protocol after the 2026-11-25 review decision: the agent-visible get_hn_item schema declares story_id as integer, matching the backend and the real Hacker News API, so the synthetic contract mismatch is no longer injected into this run. The drifting variant is kept only as the targeted contract-repair demonstration (live_demo_hard_v3.json) with its attribution control (live_demo_hard_v3_hnconsistent.json).

Budget calibration was reused from the V3 drift run (.scratch\toolguard\hard_calibration_v3.json) so that the HN schema is the only manipulated variable between the V3 and V4 artifacts: every task keeps the exact same fault-free turn requirement (and therefore the same clean+N budget) in both runs.
